Constant mint price of 0.085 ETH used in payable mint requirements.
Constant maximum token supply of 10000, bounds minting.
Private base URI used by _baseURI() for token metadata.
Block number captured when supply is exhausted, used as randomness seed.
Derived starting index for token metadata shuffling.
Boolean gate controlling whether public mint is open.
Constant cap of 15 tokens per single mint transaction.
Boolean gate controlling whether pre-sale mint is open.
Constant pre-sale supply cap of 1777 tokens.
Inherited Ownable owner address guarding privileged functions.
Deploys Incognito with name/symbol and sets initial base URI.
Owner-only setter that overwrites _baseTokenURI.
External view returning the current base token URI.
Enumerates token IDs owned by an address into a dynamic array.
Payable pre-sale mint that safe-mints one token to the caller.
Payable public mint loop safe-minting up to MAX_MINT_PER_CALL tokens.
Owner-only toggle of hasSaleStarted.
Owner-only toggle of hasPreSaleStarted.
Owner-only fund sweep using payable send of the whole balance.
Derives startingIndex from blockhash, permissionless and weakly random.
Owner-only fallback to set startingIndexBlock to the current block.
Owner-only writer of the provenance hash state variable.
Internal ERC721 mint wrapper that performs the receiver callback check.
Private ERC721 receiver hook invoking onERC721Received on contract recipients.
Ownable modifier enforcing owner equality against msg.sender.
Override hook chaining ERC721 and ERC721Enumerable transfer bookkeeping.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, ownership checks and fund withdrawal.

Low-level payable send of the full contract balance to msg.sender in withdraw.
Balance/token-count increments and decrements in mint, burn and transfer paths.
startingIndex derived from blockhash, a manipulable and timestamp/block dependent source.
Mint index and supply arithmetic (totalSupply()+1, totalSupply()+numNFTs, price*numNFTs).

edges.reason: mintPreSale safe-mints directly to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
mint safe-mints to the caller-controlled msg.sender inside the loop.
withdraw sends the entire balance to msg.sender via payable send.
Untrusted caller address is the recipient of the low-level value send.
onlyOwner gates the privileged setBaseURI writer.
onlyOwner gates the sale state toggle.
onlyOwner gates the pre-sale state toggle.
onlyOwner restricts who may withdraw contract funds.
onlyOwner restricts emergency starting index block assignment.
onlyOwner restricts provenance hash updates.
mintPreSale calls _safeMint which may invoke an untrusted receiver.
mint calls _safeMint in a loop, allowing repeated untrusted callbacks.
_safeMint performs the ERC721 receiver check.
_checkOnERC721Received makes the external receiver callback on the recipient.
Untrusted recipient contract is invoked with operator, from, tokenId and data.
Public mint loop can re-enter before state bookkeeping settles.
Pre-sale mint triggers the untrusted receiver callback.
withdraw performs the payable send of the contract balance.
setStartingIndex derives the index from blockhash, a weak block-dependent source.
startingIndex is written based on blockhash-derived value and checked for 0.
startingIndexBlock seeds the blockhash lookup in setStartingIndex.
MAX_SUPPLY is the modulo used to derive the randomized starting index.
mintPreSale reads MAX_SUPPLY for the starting index block condition.
mint compares totalSupply() plus numNFTs against MAX_SUPPLY.
mintPreSale requires msg.value to cover NFT_PRICE.
mint multiplies NFT_PRICE by numNFTs in the value requirement.
mint enforces numNFTs is at most MAX_MINT_PER_CALL.
mintPreSale bounds totalSupply against MAX_PRESALE_SUPPLY.
mint computes totalSupply()+1 and price*numNFTs arithmetic per iteration.
mintPreSale computes mintIndex as totalSupply()+1.
Pre-sale local mint index feeds the supply arithmetic.
Loop local mint index feeds the supply arithmetic.
Loop counter bounds the repeated mint arithmetic.
Caller-supplied numNFTs drives the mint loop and price multiplication.
numNFTs is an operand of the mint arithmetic.
_safeMint updates balances and owner enumerations via arithmetic.
_beforeTokenTransfer drives enumeration index arithmetic on mint/burn/transfer.
mint requires hasSaleStarted to be true.
mintPreSale requires hasPreSaleStarted to be true.
flipSaleState toggles the hasSaleStarted gate.
flipPreSaleState toggles the hasPreSaleStarted gate.
setBaseURI writes the private _baseTokenURI state.
baseURI parameter flows into the _baseTokenURI assignment.
setProvenanceHash writes INCOGNITO_HASH.
provenanceHash parameter flows into the INCOGNITO_HASH assignment.
getBaseURI reads _baseTokenURI.
tokenCount local is derived from balanceOf in tokensOfOwner.
result local array accumulates enumerated token IDs.
index local iterates the enumeration loop.
from parameter steers the transfer hook enumeration branches.
to parameter steers the transfer hook enumeration branches.
tokenId parameter is inserted or removed from enumeration structures.
_data payload is forwarded to the untrusted receiver callback.
_owner state is the authority compared by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared against the owner in the onlyOwner check.

Caller quantity parameter only drives the mint loop and price math.
Loop counter only bounds the repeated mint arithmetic.
Local token ID is a pure product of the supply arithmetic in mint.
Parameter only feeds the INCOGNITO_HASH assignment.
Source address is only used to select enumeration bookkeeping branches.
Destination address is only used to select enumeration bookkeeping branches.
Token ID parameter is only inserted/removed in enumeration mappings.
Local balance snapshot is only used to size the enumeration loop.
Local array is only the return buffer of tokensOfOwner.
Local loop index is only used to populate the result array.
Bytes payload is only forwarded into the un trusted receiver callback.
